scope: Real Pi on Linux using a live GLM model through the authenticated model gateway
method: The real Pi process made the model requests; the acceptance script did not call the provider directly.
PostgreSQL model request and usage-ledger rows were checked independently after the run.
A request carrying a credential for the completed run was rejected with HTTP 403 before a provider claim was created.
The Linux container environment was inspected for provider credentials and persistent model-gateway credentials.
limits: This is one Linux run with one live GLM model, not a multi-provider, load, or latency measurement.
The later hardening commit has deterministic focused coverage but was not the commit used for this live run.
The attempted V11 snapshot reported ready but restored filesystem content matching V10, so it is invalid evidence for a fresh Box gateway acceptance.
No fresh Box gateway acceptance is claimed by this measurement.
